nodes.title: 第 1 步 · 你的正面图
编码 · 背面（提示词）
widgets_values: Show the subject in <image1> from directly behind: the camera orbits exactly 180 degrees around the static subject at the same height and distance, an exact rear view, not a three-quarter view. Keep everything identical to <image1>: the same subject with all of its parts, shapes, materials and details, the same scale and position in the frame, the same lighting and the same plain seamless backdrop. Only the viewpoint changes, so left and right swap: what sits on the left in <image1> is now on the right, and the side of the subject that was hidden in <image1> now faces the camera. From behind we see the same design as the front, only from the rear. Invent no new features, remove nothing, and keep every part appearing exactly once, with no duplicated or mirrored copies. The whole subject is visible from the bottom of its base to its top, nothing cropped.

Take the depth and silhouette of the profile from <image2> and the front-facing details from <image1>. Invent no new features, remove nothing, and keep every part appearing exactly once, with no duplicated or mirrored copies.
